body.p: Create an HTTP instance. Upon successful creation, the communication suite instance ID shall be returned via the unsolicited reporting format "+HTTPCREATE:". The module currently supports creating only one instance of the communication suite.
<url>: Server domain name or IP address
1. The URL must conform to the protocol format: http[s]://host[:port][/[path]]. The path field in the URL shall be ignored.
2. user and password Used for websites that require authentication. Supports basic authentication.
+HTTPCREATE:0 // Returned HTTP instance ID, which shall be used as a reference for subsequent operations.
